why: Curated out of Our story on 9 October 2026 at the client's request: the page shows the founder, Why The Sphere, Wellness beyond the usual and the necessity belief, without repeating Home, Experiences, Membership or the Journal. These source lines are intentionally not on the site. The two 'right ones' lines were moved to Membership on 9 October 2026. On 9 October 2026 the Home intro, community and journal lines and the 'More than wellness' and 'Every gathering has a purpose' passages returned to Home and Experiences in the PDF's own words. On 9 October 2026 the 'Curated. Not crowded.' lines (intentionally intimate, the four elements Move, Pause, Connect and Discover) returned to Home, so Home and the Experiences page no longer repeat each other. On 12 November 2026 the '[Request an Invitation]' button line was retired: the call to action is now 'Join The Sphere' (the Membership page, then 'Join now' to Razorpay), as the client decided when Join The Sphere replaced Request an invitation. This line had only been found on the unpublished palette-study previews. On 12 November 2026 the Home 'women of The Sphere' passage was trimmed at the client's request after the audit (SPH-18): the list of roles and the line 'Curious. Intentional. Open. Evolving.' left Home, and the sentence about women building businesses, families, careers and lives they are proud of stayed. The line 'Join The Sphere' above the carnival's partner paragraph became 'Partner with us' (SPH-09).
lines: Here, wellness isn't another task on your list.
From movement and mindful practices to intimate conversations, immersive experiences and moments of stillness — every gathering is designed with intention.
The Sphere brings together women from different worlds, professions and stages of life.
The Sphere is designed for women who value privacy, meaningful connection and thoughtfully curated experiences.
Where you can discover something new.
Where you can take a breath without feeling guilty for it.
Founders. Leaders. Entrepreneurs. Creatives. Mothers. Professionals. Women building businesses, families, careers and lives they are proud of.
